v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ecce quam bonum * et quam iucúndum habitáre fratres in unum. ‡
text.en: Behold how good * and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity. ‡

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for his mercy endureth for ever.

text.la: Confitémini Dómino * quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri.
text.en: Give ye glory to the Lord * for he was mindful of us in our affliction.

text.la: Adhǽreat lingua mea * fáucibus meis, si non memínero tui Ierúsalem.
text.en: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws * if I do not remember thee, Jerusalem.

text.la: Confitébor * nómini tuo, Dómine, super misericórdia et veritáte tua.
text.en: I will give glory * to thy name, for thy mercy, and for thy truth.

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Amávit eum Dóminus, * et ornávit eum: stolam glóriæ índuit eum, et ad portas paradísi coronávit eum.
text.en: The Lord loved him * and beautified him. He clothed him with a robe of glory, and crowned him at the gates of Paradise.

text.la: Deus, qui in Ecclésia tua, nova semper instáuras exémpla virtútum: da pópulo tuo beáti Andréæ Confessóris tui atque Pontíficis ita sequi vestígia; ut assequátur et prǽmia.
text.en: O God, Who dost continually raise up in thy Church new examples of godly living, grant unto thy people so to follow in the steps of thy blessed Bishop and Confessor Andrew, that at the last they may, together with him, attain unto thine eternal reward.

office.title: S. Andreæ Corsini Episcopi et Confessoris
